releaseNotes: Player fixes: leaving the app near the end of a movie no longer restarts it from the beginning (it moves on to the next episode instead), and your resume point can no longer be lost when you jump out and straight back in. The fast-forward/rewind display no longer gets stuck on screen or carry a stale position into the next episode. Recovery on slow connections no longer buffers twice, and the Track/Speed/Buffer menus no longer stop working after you leave and come back. Update from Settings - Check for Updates.
